steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In September 2025, a guest on Equity Mates described Arista Networks as a supplier to large data centres. The conversation noted it had grown beyond a US$50 billion market cap fund limit, explaining why it fell outside that manager’s investable universe.

episode.title: Separating what's real from the hype: Roblox, Games Workshop and more - James Abela | Fidelity

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In February 2026, Equity Mates discussed a trillion dollars plus of AI infrastructure spending and said companies such as Arista Networks could capture a meaningful share, supported by commitments from Google, Apple and Microsoft. It added the main risk was if that infrastructure investment did not materialise.

episode.title: Introducing the Equity Mates Community Portfolio, house prices diverge & Corporate Travel Management’s collapse
